title: refactor(react,plugin-charts,plugin-dashboard): producers and fixtures name the declared node type they build (objectui#11479, part 1)
body:
Part of #11479. This PR carries the producers and fixtures that can name their declared node type today and still compile under the candidate V1. Card 11479 stays open for the four plugin-dashboard widget-component sites and the HTML-tier page tree. Those need a decision, and they are listed under "Held" below with the measurements.

Clause-②: no

No accept set moves. Every edit compiles on `main` with `BaseSchema`'s index signature present. The only published `.d.ts` that changes is `@object-ui/react`'s `schema-input.d.ts`, and the new spelling is the same type (proved below).

## Src sites: type before and after

| site | before | after | under the candidate V1 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| react `toRenderableSchema` parameter | the six members spelled out (`BaseSchema`, string, number, boolean, null, undefined) | `SchemaNode` (identical type today) | clean |
| plugin-charts `ObjectChart` drill table (`tableSchema`) | object literal, `type` widened to string | `ObjectDataTableSchema` | clean (was 1 error, in 2 programs) |
| plugin-dashboard `ObjectDataTable` delegate (`tableSchema`) | object literal, `type` widened to string | `DataTableSchema` | clean (was 1 error, in 2 programs) |
| plugin-dashboard `DashboardGridLayout` x2, `DashboardRenderer` x2 | cast to `BaseSchema` | **not edited, held** | 4 errors, in 2 programs |
| components `page.tsx` HTML-tier tree | cast to `BaseSchema` | **not edited, held** | covered by the candidate's own hunk |
| app-shell `ActionBarSchema` sites x4 | `ActionBarSchema` | not edited | already clean: objectui#11478 made `ActionBarSchema` an `AnySchema` member |

## Fixtures

Each fixture that widened `type` to string, or handed `SchemaRenderer` a value cast to `BaseSchema`, now names its declared node type and has no cast:

- `TextSchema`: components `guide-schema-rendering-data-context-8021`, and the `CONTENT` / `NODE` constants in types `content-channel-family-d-9256`, `content-channel-per-component-8284` and `list-tabs-item-body-refusal-9590`.
- `ButtonSchema` / `TextSchema`: the `SHIPPED` table and `SINGLE` in types `overlay-trigger-union-7081` (each `SHIPPED` row uses `satisfies`, so its keys stay addressable).
- `PublicBlockNodeOf` of `'page:tabs'` / `'page:accordion'`: app-shell `countLabels.ruAr-10242`, components `page-accordion-icon`, `page-tabs-count-badge-i18n`, `page-tabs-visibility` and `page-tabs-visible-when-fault-warning`.
- `FilterUISchema`, `SortUISchema`, `ViewSwitcherSchema`: plugin-view `handlerEventNameThroughRenderer-10616`.
- `ObjectGridSchema` and `ObjectGridBlockNode`: plugin-grid `ObjectGrid.filterContextTokens-10607`, `ObjectGrid.recordIdFilterToken-7297` and `ObjectGrid.propertiesBag-11276`. The shared `FILTER` / `SORT` rows narrow `operator` / `order` with `as const`, because they feed both node types.
- `ObjectFormBlockNode`: plugin-form `ObjectForm.i18nLabels`. The `doc()` bag parameter is the bag's own `Partial` type instead of a string-keyed `Record`.
- components `html-anchor-links`: the helper takes the anchor's own keys (`href`, `target`, `children`). Under V1 the inline `{ type: 'a', ... }` literal is judged at the prop. `HtmlElementSchema` is not exported by name, so the fixture cannot name it.
- apps/site playground: `DEFAULT_SCHEMA` is a `SchemaNode`, and `EXAMPLE_SCHEMAS` uses `satisfies` with a `Record` of `SchemaNode`, which keeps the example keys. Under V1, every nested node the playground ships checks clean.

Naming the type surfaced one fixture error, and it is fixed in the fixture. The `page:tabs` and `page:accordion` fixtures wrote `items` flat on the node, and the declared node refuses that. They now put it in the `properties` bag. `SchemaRenderer` hoists the bag onto the node before the renderer reads `items`, which is how `countLabels.ruAr-10242` already wrote it. The suites stay green (see Verification).

## Census: the candidate V1 applied, signature present, 88 programs run un-chained

Before is `main` 401611b2 with the candidate applied. After is this branch's head with the candidate applied (its `schema-input.ts` hunk excluded, because this PR carries the same change). Both columns use the probe adaptation described under "Measurement notes".

| program | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| apps/site `tsc --noEmit` | 2 | 0 |
| app-shell test | 1 | 0 |
| components test | 32 | 14 |
| layout test | 5 | 5 |
| plugin-charts src / test | 1 / 1 | 0 / 0 |
| plugin-dashboard src / test | 5 / 6 | 4 / 5 |
| plugin-form test | 2 | 1 |
| plugin-gantt test | 1 | 1 |
| plugin-grid test | 3 | 0 |
| plugin-map test | 1 | 1 |
| plugin-view test | 6 | 0 |
| react test | 65 | 65 |
| types test | 38 | 6 |
| **total** | **169 in 15 programs** | **102 in 9 programs** |

The other 73 programs are exit 0 in both columns. The 67 cleared lines are this card's: 4 src lines (2 sites), plus 63 fixture lines (58 widened fixtures and 5 `BaseSchema`-typed values).

By cause, against the card's split (the card's numbers are from 5988b6b5 and are not re-derived here):

- Widened fixtures, 71: 58 cleared. 13 re-sorted to objectui#11466. 11 of those are react literals of test-only types (`identity-probe`, `self-updating-probe`, `test:probe-4795`), which need `CustomNodeRegistry`. The other 2 are `react-page-adapter` / `react-page-invalidation` `home` page documents, which name a real type but lack the spec's required `label`, the same refusal as the two `home` literals.
- `BaseSchema`-typed values, 15: 5 cleared. 3 re-sorted to objectui#11466 (react `probe-3955`, `probe-7530` and `test:schema-input-bridge-8908`, all test-only types). 7 are held (see "Held").
- `type: string` probe interfaces, 9: none is mine. All nine wrap a test-only type (`test-widget` x4, `stable-widget` x2, `test-component`, `self-updating-probe`, `test:probe-4795`), so naming a type cannot clear them without `CustomNodeRegistry`. Re-sorted to objectui#11466.
- objectui#11466's own set, unchanged: 46 test-only or unknown-type literals (the card's 43, plus 3 in the new layout `navigation-responsive-grid-retired-11441`), 4 old-shape pins, 2 parity rows, 4 `element:text` literals, and 2 `home` literals (4 with the re-sort). Two more go there too: the pivot `drillDown` refusal and the smoke test's runtime-built `{ type }` node.
- The 2 metric-card literals no longer error (objectui#11467). The 1 app-shell `ActionBarSchema` value no longer errors (objectui#11478).

## Held: not edited, needs a decision

1. **plugin-dashboard widget-component producers (`DashboardGridLayout` x2, `DashboardRenderer` x2).** I annotated `getComponentSchema` with the widget component slot type (`DashboardWidgetSchema['component']`) and removed the cast, as a trial that was then reverted. Today only the passthrough branch fails: it spreads a widget whose `type` is optional. Under V1, naming the type surfaces the producer's own mismatches, 7 in `DashboardGridLayout` and 9 in `DashboardRenderer`:
   - `chartType` is typed as a plain string (the dispatch's `chartType`);
   - the flat `object-metric` node: its only declared form is the `properties`-bag `ObjectMetricBlockNode`;
   - `type: DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES.metric`, that is `plugin-dashboard:metric`, has no TypeScript declaration;
   - the passthrough;
   - the pivot branch's `options` spread;
   - the filter-merge spread.

   The metric node needs either a `packages/types/src` declaration or a `CustomNodeRegistry` entry, which only exists with V1. So per the dispatch these four sites stop here.
2. **components `page.tsx`.** The tree comes from `@object-ui/sdui-parser`'s `compile()`, typed `SchemaElement` (`type` is a plain string, plus an `unknown` index signature). It is author source parsed at runtime and validated against the runtime manifest (`validateTree`) before it renders. That is the measured producer of genuinely untyped input that triggers the card's option B, so it is a stop-and-report and not edited. The candidate's own hunk retargets the existing cast to `DeclaredNode`.
3. **Seven test values that deliberately hand `SchemaRenderer` a shape no declared node type covers.**
   - The runtime-flat action-node fixtures in components `action-button-icon-inputs-11168`, `action-group-menu-inputs-11168` and `action-container-member-params-10290`. A trial conversion of the first to the `properties` bag surfaced 8 further fixture errors, so it is a rewrite, not an annotation, and was reverted.
   - The node-level `params` in `action-params-templates-7867` CASE A. The helper's `BaseSchema` arm exists for this deliberately refused spelling.
   - The unjudged stored-document JSON in plugin-gantt and plugin-map `propertiesBag-10859`, which their own comments call deliberate.
   - The `onCancel` host slot (a function) merged into the node in plugin-form `MasterDetailForm.i18nLabels`.

## Measurement notes

- **The candidate V1 patch applies to 401611b2 as text (`git apply --check` exit 0) but no longer compiles there.** objectui#11468 joined `FlexBlockNode` into `AuthoringNode`. That type is derived from `typeof FlexBlockSchema`, whose bag `children` slot references `SchemaNodeSchema`. So the types build fails with TS2456 on `FlexBlockNode`, `AuthoringNode`, `DeclaredNode` and `SchemaNode`, plus TS4109 and four TS7022 (the downstream react error disappears with them). Pre-annotating the flex children slots, the candidate's own trick, does not clear it.
- **Probe adaptation.** For both census columns, a copy of the candidate plus one line dropping `FlexBlockNode` from `AuthoringNode` was used. It was throwaway and never committed. Its cost is 2 artefact errors in types `authoring-nodes-bag-carriers-11468`, included in both totals.
- **`schema-input.ts`.** This PR carries the candidate's `schema-input.ts` change, byte-identical, so the candidate's hunk for it stops applying once this lands.
- **Census-only casts.** For the after column, plugin-dashboard's four held sites got census-only casts in the throwaway worktree so that plugin-dashboard and app-shell could build. The plugin-dashboard figures in the table are its real, uncast readings.
- **`main` has moved.** `main` has advanced since 401611b2, including objectui#11440 (arms page kinds and other node types) and objectui#11474 (gap steps). Neither touches a file this PR changes. Their effect on the V1 readings (for example the `home` literals) is NOT MEASURED.

## Verification

- **Type-check today** (signature present), every program of every touched package, un-chained: react, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, components, app-shell, plugin-view, types (all three programs), plugin-grid and plugin-form (both programs each), and apps/site (`fumadocs-mdx`, `next typegen`, `tsc`). All exit 0, 0 errors.
- **vitest** from the worktree root, on the 17 changed test files plus `packages/plugin-charts/`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/`, react `schema-input.bridgeFidelity` and `SchemaRenderer.propsResolution`: Test Files 264 passed (264), Tests 3578 passed, 15 skipped.
- **Emitted `.d.ts`.** After rebuilding, only react `schema-input.d.ts` differs (the import and the parameter spelling). plugin-charts and plugin-dashboard `.d.ts` are byte-identical.
- **Type identity.** A throwaway type-level assertion against the rebuilt dist shows that `toRenderableSchema`'s parameter equals the six-member union (compiles). A control that drops number and boolean goes red (TS2344), so the check can fail. The file was then deleted, and `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes.
- **Reverse verification** on `ObjectChart`'s drill table, from the committed state. A wrong value (`pagination: 'yes'`) is red with the annotation (TS2322) and green with the annotation removed (exit 0). Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, and the blob hash equals HEAD's.
- **Gates.** `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` reported 0 new citations. `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-types` exit 0. `check:component-surface-parity` and `check:sdui-registration-pins` were not run, because no registration input moved.
- **eslint** on the 20 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (package `eslint .` semantics): 0 errors and 70 warnings. Each file's counts equal its own count at 401611b2. Repo-wide lint is CI's.
